_comment: EXAMPLE allowlist-primary profile (ROADMAP R7) — adapt the allow list to your repo; NOT turnkey. defaultMode 'dontAsk' auto-denies anything not in permissions.allow, BUT read-only Bash (cat/rg/grep/head/…) still runs, so the Read(.env*) deny does NOT stop `cat .env` via Bash — it only governs Claude's Read/Glob/Grep tools. Protect repo-local secrets with hygiene (don't commit real secrets; use env injection / a secret manager) and the network sandbox below (limits exfiltration), not with this deny alone. See managed/README.md 'Allowlist-primary profile (R7)'. Verified against code.claude.com 2026-05-31.
